title: Patch notes: Fiorne's stacks, lobby fixes and balance
subtitle: FANGS Community Edition · 21 October 2026
intro: Fiorne gets her Bunny Stacks every match again, the Captain vote and custom lobbies work properly, and more changes from the community's list (thanks to everyone who tested).
To get it: start the game through the launcher as usual; it updates itself.

sections.name: Highlights
items: Fiorne's Bunny Stacks: about every second match she had none (no Space all match). The server now notices within a few seconds and gives them back.
Captain vote stays on when the lobby owner turns it on (it used to switch itself off again).
Custom lobbies no longer get stuck before hero select when the owner starts with fewer players than the lobby size.
Balance: Fiorne's damage toned down, Rowan's healing back to how it was, Ethryn's augments nerfed.

sections.name: General
items: Lobby settings: a changed map, size, rounds or Captain vote no longer flicks back for a moment before the server confirms it.
Wylde's reload is covered by the same safety net as Fiorne's stacks, so a whole match with no reloads can't happen that way anymore.

sections.name: Heroes
heroes: Knight's Prayer Book: armor stacks up to 4 times (was 6).
Dawncleave: each Pummel stack makes enemies take 7% more damage (was 9%).
Brawler's Aegis: Pummel's stun deals 30 bonus damage (was 40).
Elysian Warbrew: Talon Strike's bonus damage is 2% of her current HP (was 2.5%).
Matriarch's Halo: Ironclad Slam heals 10% of her missing HP per enemy hit (was 12%).
Damage toned down (health, Space and Shift unchanged): LMB 45 → 38, passive attack speed +100% → +75%, RMB 40 → 30 per parry, E 85 → 75, R about 365 → 275 in total.
Passive healing is back to how much it healed before the last patches: from 90 HP a Sourblossom heals you to about 645 HP (about 795 with Heal Sprite), instead of about 340 (450).
The heal now always follows how hurt you are right now, also when you get hit while standing in the Overgrowth.
Tooltips show the real numbers: the passive heals 7.2% of your missing HP per second, Heal Sprite adds 65%.
Fixed: when an Earth Rend area or your ult's Overgrowth (The Bloomblade) ended while you also stood in a Sourblossom's ring, the Sourblossom stopped healing you until you stepped out and back in.

sections.name: Coming next
items: Wylde's E (Lamblaster) holding back his next shot for about a second.
Reconnecting to a custom game after a crash or disconnect.

outro: Thanks for all the reports! Keep them coming.
